Time To Wake Up launches on PlayStation 5 on September 12.

Time To Wake Up is an atmospheric psychological thriller where you find yourself trapped inside a dream. Can you find a way to wake up?

One night, you hear a mysterious voice asking for your eyes, and suddenly you find yourself trapped in a dream filled with memories of your school days. To escape, you'll need to make peace with your inner child and confront the shadows of your past.

Take a deep breath, watch your step, and above all: blink and refresh your memory.

Wishlist Aether & Iron on the PlayStation Store today! 

The award-winning decopunk tactical RPG is officially making its way to PlayStation!

Step into an alternate 1930s timeline where advanced anti-gravity technology has lifted New York City into the clouds. Build your crew, customize your fleet of vehicles, navigate intense grid-based combat lanes, and lead an underground resistance movement to tear down the corporate elite hoarding the skies. Your strategic choices will dictate who survives the lower islands.

Stay tuned for future release date announcements!
